# Welcome {-}
Welcome to the book [Biomedical Data Science - an introduction with case studies](https://statbiomed.github.io/BMDS-book/). 
Most contents are demonstrated with R programming language.

This book is designed as a collection of R Markdown notebooks, as supplementary 
to the lecture notes for the course 
[BBMS1021: Introduction to AI and Biomedical Data Science](https://www.biomedsc.hku.hk),
an undergraduate course (Year 1) at the University of Hong Kong. It can also 
support general readers who are new to (biomedical) data science, including
students in a master programme course 
[SBMS7202 Foundations in Biomedical Data Science](https://mbioinno.hku.hk).

**Note:** Most contents may be only updated right before or after the lectures, 
so please refer to the updated version.


**GitHub Repository:** you can find the source files on
[StatBiomed/BMDS-book](https://github.com/StatBiomed/BMDS-book) and the way to re-build this book.
